title: TI Corp original vector recovery
datePolicy: Publication dates establish dated specimens, not adoption or first use.

assets.label: Full colour, Summer 2025 project update
assets.provenance: Official publication, original native vector paths extracted; not a supplied standalone master.
assets.dateMeaning: Date printed on the source publication, not an adoption or first-use date.
assets.notes: Full-colour TI Corp lockup recovered from the official Pattullo Bridge Replacement Project Summer 2025 Project Update, page 1. The emblem, divider and all lettering are original vector paths. The website PNG remains available as a separate specimen. PDF print colours are converted to sRGB; this is an extraction from a publication, not a separately published SVG master.
assets.method: PyMuPDF 1.26.6 PDF-to-SVG conversion, preserving selected source path nodes, ancestor transforms and referenced clipping definitions. Unrelated artwork, page backgrounds, raster images and unused definitions excluded. All lettering was already outlined in the PDF. No tracing, type recreation or recolouring; PDF print colours converted to sRGB by MuPDF. Intrinsic width is 780px with proportional height for display; the PDF-coordinate viewBox and geometry are retained.
